title: Plains Cree language - Wikipedia
text: Plains Cree (endonym: ᓀᐦᐃᔭᐍᐏᐣ nēhiyawēwin; alternatively: ᐸᐢᑳᐧᐃᐧᓃᒧᐃᐧᐣ paskwâwinîmowin "language of the prairie people" [5]) is a dialect of the Algonquian language Cree, the most populous Canadian indigenous language.

title: okimawᐅᑭᒪᐤ
